miners.name: LiveCert — Sourced Answers for Agents
miners.description: Sourced answers for agents and apps across 44 intents, each read live from a named primary source so the caller can check it. Every answer opens with a one-sentence answer, then returns the values as fields, the source and the time it was checked. Compliance: sanctions screening of people, companies and wallets against the OFAC SDN and UN lists with near-match scores; company register records (status, company number, register, registered address and agent, parents) from GLEIF and SEC EDGAR; SEC filings with acceptance times and each 10-Q or 10-K's own XBRL figures; URL reputation from Cloudflare and Quad9 threat DNS, each source named. Research: question answering with every claim cited, web search with dated reports, fact checks with the source URL and evidence sentence, and academic, clinical and news search. Markets: prices and market data for coins, tokens and listed companies, 10-K revenue and earnings, exchange rates and macroeconomic prints (US CPI and unemployment from BLS, the federal funds target range from the New York Fed, euro-area HICP from Eurostat and ECB rates). On-chain: transfer verification with confirmations and the burned base fee, transaction and contract activity across EVM chains, wallet balances, gas, token holders, ERC-20 total supply and burned balance read at a pinned block from two RPCs, any named value read at a stated block height (receipt gas and Transfer amounts, storage slots, balances, block gas), and cross-chain messages. Security: live TLS certificates, URL scans, CVE records, DNS records compared across two resolvers, security reviews of packages, sites and code, and fraud signals. Weather: forecasts, current conditions and storm risk. Also translation, IP geolocation, event outcomes, text extraction, sentiment and classification. A language model (Groq gpt-oss-120b, with two fallbacks) writes chat replies, code and security reviews and requested writing, and chooses sentiment labels, fact-check ratings, news briefs and, with no market or record, recalled event outcomes; each field is checked before it is served, the request is passed as data, and a keyless answer or an honest unknown is given when no model answers. Everything else is computed, not generated.

miners.name: PREFLIGHT Infrastructure Signals
miners.description: Deterministic infrastructure and on-chain signals for autonomous systems, each read live at question time. TLS verification performs a real handshake with chain, hostname and validity checks; URL safety combines redirects, headers and threat feeds; DNS records come from two independent DoH resolvers; uptime and API health are probed with per-phase timings. Gas, balances, transactions, token supply and pinned-block reads come straight from public JSON-RPC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Linea, Scroll, Gnosis, zkSync Era, Blast, Mantle, Celo, Sonic and Unichain. Prices, TVL, FX, geolocation, papers and CVEs come from named public sources, cited in each answer.

miners.name: NewsWire Verified News Search

Return fetched publisher quotes, original links, available bylines and source-specific licences. Verify original government publication dates before selecting up to five reports. Recent direct matches precede background mentions and explicitly dated archives. Explicit today and bounded past-day, week or hour requests constrain original publication dates in UTC. Query and answer reuse is at most 60 seconds; catalog and government metadata reuse is at most 300 seconds, preserving original fetch times. miners.name: ChainSight — Universal Intelligence & Data Oracle
miners.description: A single high-reliability provider that answers ANY request across conversation, search, research, verification, language, finance, crypto/on-chain, security, weather, logistics and IoT. Routes here for: general conversational questions and chat; open-ended Q&A and knowledge; web search and current news; deep research and academic/scholarly lookups; fact-checking and claim/content verification; translation, summarization, rewriting and text generation; sentiment, classification, moderation, AI-text and authenticity detection; live crypto prices, market cap, DeFi TVL and yields, fiat FX, gas, wallet balances, on-chain transactions, token supply and holders; stock and macro indicators; fraud, sanctions, threat-intel, CVE and vulnerability, URL/email/SSL security, code review and generation; weather, air-quality and geolocation; shipping, port, warehouse, package and vessel logistics; sensor, grid, datacenter and validator telemetry. Every answer is direct, grounded in a real source, number-first for quantitative intents, low-latency and never empty. Broad coverage with specialist-grade quality on each intent — a reliable default the router can trust for almost any question.
